name: Website Hybrid RAG Pipeline — Webhook → Apify → Embed → Supabase

parameters.jsCode: const body=$json.body||{}; let url=String(body.website||'').trim(); if(!url)throw new Error('Missing required field: body.website'); if(!/^https?:\/\//i.test(url))url='https://'+url; return [{json:{website:url}}];

const size=50,pages=$input.all().map(i=>i.json),out=[]; const runId=`${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10)}`; for(let i=0;i<pages.length;i+=size){const batch=pages.slice(i,i+size); out.push({json:{meta:{source:'website_crawler',runId,timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),batchNumber:out.length+1,batchSize:batch.length,totalBatches:Math.ceil(pages.length/size),totalPages:pages.length},pages:batch}});} return out;

nodes.name: Receive Web Pages to Chunk + Embed

assignments.name: metadata
assignments.value: ={{ { url: $json.url, page_title: $json.page_title, page_type: $json.page_type, site: $json.site, chunk_index: $json.chunk_index, content_hash: $json.content_hash, crawled_at: $json.crawled_at } }}
